sections.voiceover: In Japan, 1 out of 10 healthy office workers suffer from low back pain. Tohoku University researchers built smart sensor-equipped chairs to tackle this exact physical toll. How high does spinal load climb in a rounded posture to reach 190%?

sections.voiceover: North America's office chair market hit $4.5 billion last year, but demand keeps surging.
